enchantments.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).

Proof Against Disease +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
Quality Fortitude Save +3: This item gives a +3 Quality bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
